name: Imprompt
summary: Chrome extension that rewrites your prompts on ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini and chats with any webpage.
description: Imprompt adds an Enhance button to the prompt box on ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini, and a side panel that answers questions about the page you are on. It runs locally through Chrome's built-in AI (Manifest V3); build it from source or load the release zip.
contains: Enhance button for ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini prompt boxes
side panel to ask questions about the current webpage
runs locally via Chrome built-in AI, no servers or tracking
built with React, Plasmo, TypeScript, Shadcn and Tailwind
